newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DUBLIN'S INJURY TIME GOAL EARNS COVENTRY A POINT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUBLIN'S INJURY TIME GOAL EARNS COVENTRY A POINT.

text.p: Substitute Dion Dublin scored his first goal of the season to snatch a last-gasp equaliser for Coventry in the bottom-of-the-table premier league clash with Southampton on Sunday.
Dublin, relegated to the substitutes' bench after Coventry had managed only three goals in eight premier league matches, struck deep into injury time.
Paul Telfer's long-range shot was parried by goalkeeper Neil Moss and Dublin was on hand to bury the rebound.
Coventry, in control for much of the game, had fallen behind in the 17th minute to a goal conjured out of nothing by England striker Matt Le Tissier.
He struck a 30-metre drive past goalkeeper Steve Ogrizovic into the top corner of the net.
